x-invariants: Creation mode is immutable; effective access/verification/writer state are current observations. SETTLING must expose active owner or required recovery.

Stable captured head and opaque cursor survive paging. Oversized content becomes complete artifact refs; one large item cannot block a page. Advisory heartbeat head never advances delivered cursor or establishes a gap. Timeline-only degradation cannot suppress pending interactions.

Protected answers and credential bytes never enter model/browser/safe projection fields. Resolution rechecks current Controller/request/Run/Turn/generation; absent owner leads to bounded decline/interruption.
Offset and complete length/hash bind bounded chunk reads; partial bytes cannot be treated as complete content.

x-unchangedContracts: Machine/v4 and frozen public/v1 keep their own envelopes and supported read/recovery meanings.
Existing unchanged operations use their original checked requests; v5 does not accept an arbitrary JSON payload.
x-runtimeAvailability: All newly introduced successor methods remain unavailable until their owning implementing Task completes qualification.
